title: Composer preset
description: A named settings document (R-754): the preferences a style of her listening sets, with the accompaniment pattern it travels with. A request names it with `preset`; its own `preferences` apply over it.

source.description: Where the settings come from: the references and the listening rounds.

pattern.description: The accompaniment pattern the preset travels with (an id of a K11 accompaniment entry); the request's own accompaniment wins.
